messages.text: Man City sign Fernandez in British-record-equalling deal

metadata.summary: Manchester City have signed Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea for a joint-British-record fee of £125m.
metadata.content: Enzo Fernandez transfer news: Man City sign midfielder from Chelsea in British-record-equalling £125m deal | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Enzo Fernandez transfer news: Man City sign midfielder from Chelsea in British-record-equalling £125m deal Enzo Fernandez joins Man City from Chelsea for £125m; Fee matches British record Liverpool paid Newcastle for Alexander Isak last summer; Chelsea furious that Monaco pulled out of deal to sell Lamine Camara as replacement for Fernandez Wednesday 2 September 2026 01:55, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Manchester City welcome Enzo Fernandez with dramatic intro video after his £125 million transfer from Chelsea. Credit: Manchester City Manchester City have signed Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea for a joint-British-record fee of £125m. The size of the fee matches the amount Liverpool paid Newcastle for Alexander Isak on Deadline Day a year ago. The Argentine midfielder has signed a five-year deal at the Etihad Stadium. The Fernandez deal comes amid Chelsea fury that Monaco pulled out of selling Lamine Camara - who was deemed as the Argentine's replacement - in the final minutes of the window. Chelsea had the option of pulling the plug on Fernandez to Man City after the Camara deal collapsed - but they stuck to their word and honoured their commitment to complete the deal. messages.text: Fery outclassed by Musetti on US Open debut

metadata.summary: Arthur Fery's hopes of a fairy-tale debut run at the US Open were ended in the first round by a straight-sets defeat to Lorenzo Musetti at Flushing Meadows.
metadata.content: US Open 2026: Arthur Fery beaten by Lorenzo Musetti in straight sets on Flushing Meadows debut | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open 2026: Arthur Fery beaten by Lorenzo Musetti in straight sets on Flushing Meadows debut Arthur Fery's US Open debut ends in first-round defeat to Lorenzo Musetti; British No 1's hopes of another Grand Slam fairy tale after Wimbledon dashed in straight-sets loss; watch the US Open live on Sky Sports Tennis, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app Jack Wilkinson Sports Journalist @jacktwilkinson Wednesday 2 September 2026 00:52, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of Arthur Fery against Lorenzo Musetti from the US Open. Arthur Fery's hopes of a fairy-tale debut run at the US Open were ended in the first round by a straight-sets defeat to Lorenzo Musetti at Flushing Meadows. One week on from reaching the final of the Winston-Salem Open, Fery's hopes to replicating his magical run to the Wimbledon semi-finals were dashed in a clinical 6-3 6-3 7-5 defeat to the 13th seed. Fery was crucially broken in the eighth game of the first set as back-to-back double faults gifted the initiative to Musetti, who broke serve again to wrap up the opener 6-3.
